# Effect ratings

<!-- Generated by scripts/effect-score.js --write on 2026-11-05. Edit the script, not this page. -->

Generated on 2026-11-05 by `node scripts/effect-score.js --write` (95 effects; measuring took 1217 s). The same numbers are in
[`packages/engine/src/ratings.js`](../../packages/engine/src/ratings.js) (`RATINGS`, `AUTO`, `rating(id)`, exported from
`@tempolight/engine`). See [director and effects](director-and-effects.md) for how effects are chosen.

## How effects are measured

Every built-in effect runs on its own (no switching) through the real director and effects on the example room at 60 fps,
over synthetic songs whose beats, kicks, snares and song parts are known: the feel harness' EDM song at 128 and 150 BPM
(intro, build-up, drop, breakdown, build-up, drop), a pop song at 116 BPM (quiet verse, louder chorus, drums), the same
song without drums, a minor ballad at 64 BPM (no drums), hip-hop (88), half-time (140) and drum and bass (174) grooves,
and four-on-the-floor grooves at 90 and 174 BPM (with the EDM and pop songs: a series where only the tempo changes).
The beat grid and the song parts come from the songs' truth, so an effect is judged on what it does with the right
signals; the live analyser supplies the spectrum, waveform and bass level, as in the app. Each effect runs twice: raw
(manual mode, no kick pump, no drop flash, no ambient fill) and with the feel layer at its defaults (a one-effect show in
automatic mode: kick pump, dynamics, variations). Measured per kind of song part:

- **kick contrast**: (peak in the 120 ms after a kick - trough in the 120 ms before) / peak, median and 10th percentile, raw and with the feel layer
- **beat sync**: correlation of the brightness, or of how much changes, with an impulse on each kick (snare in build-ups)
- **brightness**: mean (an effect darker than a third of the part's target can't be evened out: the director's gain stops at 3x) and its bar-to-bar change
- **flicker**: big brightness jumps per second that aren't on a hit or an eighth note (strobing that ignores the beat)
- **alive**: how much changes between kicks; **spatial**: how much of the room lights up within each beat
- **build response**: does the brightness or movement rise through the build-up, and does it hit the snare roll
- **calm**: smooth (no jumps), gently moving, uses the room, follows the music's loudness

Weights per role (each part 0..1, the score is the weighted sum x 100):

- drop: kick 0.22, kickP10 0.1, kickFeel 0.04, sync 0.14, bright 0.14, steady 0.04, clean 0.08, alive 0.12, spatial 0.12
- build: rise 0.24, riseX 0.14, snare 0.14, bright 0.12, clean 0.1, alive 0.12, spatial 0.14
- calm: bright 0.16, smooth 0.2, clean 0.1, alive 0.2, spatial 0.16, steady 0.08, follow 0.1

Traits: **tempo** is the range of song tempos (the four-on-the-floor series 90, 116, 128, 150, 174; calm effects: 64, 116, 128,
150) where the effect's score (for its own role; build-up effects: the drop score) stays within 92% of its best;
an open end at the slowest or fastest song is 60 or 180; **kick-driven**: raw kick contrast >= 0.3 and beat sync >= 0.3; **needs a beat**: without drums
(the pop song's notes alone) it is less than 55% as bright, or less than 35% as lively and not brighter; **busy**: change per frame, 0.1 = 1; **energy**:
brightness, busyness and kick contrast in drops.

## Automatic picks

The curated effects automatic mode picks from (only effects with the role's tag that score clearly well, best first):

- **drop** (15): ping, shock, eq, burst, kaleido, spin, zigzag, laser, portal, split, strobe, wipe, roomeq, kaleido2, meteor
- **build** (8): comets, vortex, tstrobe, helix, implode, storm, riser, countdown
- **calm** (8): flow, candle, hypno, lava, ocean, plasma, sunrise, colorchord

## Weak or broken

- **heart** (calm): flickers (1.903 off-beat jumps per second)
- **confetti** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.062 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target); uses little of the room (14% of LEDs per beat)
- **rings** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.065 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target); uses little of the room (14% of LEDs per beat)
- **disco** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.062 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target)
- **rgbsplit** (drop): barely reacts to the kick (raw kick contrast 0.087, 0.534 with the feel layer)
- **pong** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.034 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target); barely reacts to the kick (raw kick contrast 0, 0.531 with the feel layer)
- **balls** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.062 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target); barely reacts to the kick (raw kick contrast 0.056, 0.567 with the feel layer)
- **strobechase** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.064 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target)
- **chorus** (drop): barely reacts to the kick (raw kick contrast 0.086, 0.712 with the feel layer)
- **bassrain** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.054 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target)
- **beatcount** (drop): barely reacts to the kick (raw kick contrast 0.079, 0.54 with the feel layer)
- **neon** (calm): flickers (1.215 off-beat jumps per second)
- **scope** (drop): dark (mean brightness 0.055 in its parts; even lifted 3x it stays under 60% of the 0.34 target)
